**Anti-patterns view — catalogue grouped by scope (#882 PR 3)**

lib/anti-patterns-model.mjs builds one row per anti-pattern entry, core before project, sorted by id within each scope, reusing governance-model.mjs's row() helper for each file's own sourceStamp. renderAntiPatterns draws the catalogue for real; each cited issue is stamped [forge: #N] as text (no fabricated link, since the parser only ever extracts a bare number). An unlistable scope is said beside the other scope's real rows. Full suite 5879/5879, counted diff 134/1000.
